content: Adam orumburumbuye
Iyake Adam orumburumbuye ghanjiriuriu. Mbaŋa Loi i vakatha lolo, va i vakatha tembe ŋgoreiyeva amalaghɨniyeko ghayamoyamo.
I vakathaŋgi, ghɨmoru na wevo, i mwaewo weŋgi na i giya idanji “Gharɨgharɨ.”
Mbaŋa Adam ghatheghathegha vama i wo hothaŋarɨ na hweto (130), na mbowo thɨ ghambɨva narinji regha. Ghayamoyamo mbe ŋgora vara amalaghɨniye, na i rena idae Set.
Mbaŋa Set i virɨ na e ghereiye, Adam yawaliye molao, i yaku theghathegha hoseriyewa (800). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Adam va i yaku vara theghathegha hoseriyesiwo na hweto (930), ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Set ghatheghathegha vama i wo hothaŋarɨ na umbolima (105) amba thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Inos.
Mbaŋa Inos i virɨ na e ghereiye, Set yawaliye vambe molaova, i yaku theghathegha hoseriyewa na umbopirɨ (807). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Set va i yaku vara theghathegha hoseriyesiwo na hoyaworo na umboiwo (912), ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Inos ghatheghathegha vama i wo hwesiwo (90) amba thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Kenan.
Mbaŋa Kenan i virɨ na e ghereiye, Inos yawaliye vambe molaova, i yaku theghathegha hoseriyewa na hoyaworo na umbolima (815). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Inos va i yaku vara theghathegha hoseriyesiwo na umbolima (905) ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Kenan ghatheghathegha vama i wo hwepirɨ (70) amba thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Mahalalel.
Mbaŋa Mahalalel i virɨ na e ghereiye, Kenan yawaliye vambe molaova, i yaku theghathegha hweseriyewa na hwevarɨ (840). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Kenan va i yaku vara theghathegha hweseriyesiwo na hoyaworo (910) ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Mahalalel ghatheghathegha vama i wo hwewona na umbolima (65) amba thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Jered.
Mbaŋa Jered i virɨ na e ghereiye, Mahalalel yawaliye vambe molaova, i yaku theghathegha hweseriyewa na hweto (830). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Mahalalel va i yaku vara theghathegha hweseriyewa na hwesiwo na umbolima (895), ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Jered ghatheghathegha vama i wo hothaŋarɨ na hwewona na umboiwo (162) amba thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Inok.
Mbaŋa Inok i virɨ na e ghereiye, Jered yawaliye vambe molaova, i yaku theghathegha hweseriyewa (800). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Jered va i yaku vara theghathegha hweseriyesiwo na hwewona na umboiwo (962), ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Inok ghatheghathegha vama i wo hwewona na umbolima (65) ambama thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Metuisela.
Mbaŋa Metuisela i virɨ na e ghereiye Inok i yaku na ghamwae vanaora weiye Loi theghathegha hweseriyeto (300) e tɨne na i ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Va i yaku na yawaliye le molamolao ŋgoreiya theghathegha hweseriyeto hwewona na umbolima (365).
Inok i yaku na ghamwae vanaora weiye Loi ghaghadɨ vambema i roghawe eŋge kaiwae Loi vama i vaŋgu.
Mbaŋa Metuisela ghatheghathegha vama i wo hothaŋarɨ hwewa na umbopirɨ (187) ambama thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru, idae Lemeki.
Mbaŋa Lemeki i virɨ na e ghereiye Metuisela i yaku mbaŋa molao, theghathegha hweseriyepirɨ hwewa na umboiwo (782). E lughawoghawoko iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Metuisela va i yaku vara theghathegha hweseriyesiwo hwewona na umbosiwo (969), ko amba i mare eŋge.
Mbaŋa Lemeki ghatheghathegha vama i wo hothaŋarɨ hwewa na umboiwo (182) thɨ ghamba ŋgama ghɨmoru,
na iŋa, “E thelauke vara iya Giya Loi va i gurake, ŋgamake iyake ne i vatowoŋainda e vuyowoke tɨne,” iya kaiwae i rena idae Nowa.
Lemeki vambowo i yakuva theghathegha hweseriyelima hwesiwo na umbolima (595). E lughawoghawo iyako vambe thɨ ghambɨŋgiva gamagai vavana.
Lemeki va i yaku vara theghathegha hweseriyepirɨ hwepirɨ na umbopirɨ (777), ko amba i mare eŋge.
Nowa vama ghatheghathegha hoseriyelima (500) iko, ko amba thɨ ghambɨŋgi le ŋgaŋga thenjigheto, mbe ghɨmoghɨmoruŋgi eŋge. Idaidanji Sem, Ham na Japet.

footnotes.text: Idake iyake Nowa ghaloŋwaloŋwa ŋgoreiye utu regha i mena Hibru ghalɨŋanji gharumwaru “vatowoŋa”.
